Pathfinder Worker:
The Rim Kamaloka is a type of defense. The dark energy uses the unconscious as a path to invasion, and can erode the target. The targets end up dying.

That's why we want to go into the unconscious and get rid of the monsters that appear there.

We create a dream space in the form of a solo instanced zone to connect adventurers.

I will evaluate how you defeat monsters in that space. If you last for 5 minutes, I'll provide a Reward based on your evaluation.
